title: Sleep Disturbances and Pulmonary Artery/Aorta Diameter in Scleroderma Patient
brief_summary: To determine sleep disturbance, pulmonary function test, 6 minute walk, echocardiogram abnormality, arterial blood gas, ventilation/perfusion scan of the chest in Scleroderma patient with Pulmonary Hypertension.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient must have Scleroderma

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who do not have Scleroderma
study_population:
Males, Females and Minorities

Age range of subjects 18-75 years old
